description: Twelve independently authored transfer holdouts, locked before a context-layout implementation or model generation. New subjects and materials do not replace the earlier 89 inputs, oracles, or canonical safeguards. Automated claim patterns are bounded literal-value guards, not semantic acceptance; every clause, sentence count, line count, heading, exact support identity, raw draft, and displayed response requires manual review. Faithful paraphrases are accepted except exact page names, requested headings, and the explicit abstention. Citation markers do not count as prose; supporting quotations remain in raw cited JSON and source context, not appended as extra answer sentences.
canonicalBoundary: Seed through actual canonical service commands. Retain before/after typed canonical rows and asset bytes and unchanged mutation counts, using the existing canonical audit without reducing its protected inventory. Operational AI draft state remains subject to the existing exclusion only.
